To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) ELU activations are more robust than ReLU activations; 2) SqueezeNet-like architectures are better suited for image segmentation than VGG-like architectures; 3) parallel dilated convolutional layers are better suited for segmentation than dilated convolutional blocks; 4) SharpMask-like refinement networks are more accurate than FCN-like refinement networks; 5) our architecture achieves higher segmentation accuracy on Cityscapes than other networks that were tailored to embedded devices; 6)

1) ELU activation functions improve accuracy and reduce computation, 2) a SqueezeNet encoder with dilated convolutions is sufficient to achieve high segmentation accuracy, 3) SharpMask-like refinement improves segmentation accuracy.
